tools.name: list_vehicle_options
tools.description: Returns valid years, makes, and models in the Trail Fortress catalogue. Use this before guessing model spelling (Wrangler JK, 1500, F-150, and so on).

year.description: Optional model year to narrow makes and models.

make.description: Optional make to narrow models, for example Ford or Jeep.

tools.name: find_parts_for_vehicle
tools.description: Returns a fitment-checked listing URL and in-stock parts with listable prices only. Manufacturer exclusions are on each product page.

category.description: Optional category slug, for example lift-kits.

tools.name: check_part_fit
tools.description: Returns fits, does_not_fit, or unknown using manufacturer application data. Never guesses when data is missing.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Returns title, brand, part number, listable price (MAP for Rough Country), availability, key facts, and manufacturer exclusions. No cost or trade pricing.

tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Full-text and part-number search over listed products with listable prices only.

tools.name: tire_fitment
tools.description: Returns verified tire sizes, stated max tire claims, lift-only notes, and matching wheels from manufacturer strings already in the catalogue.

tire.description: Optional tire size token, for example 33x12.50R20.
